messages:
maya: Heads up — need to land hotfix PR #15234 before Wed deploy freeze (cutoff 2026-03-18 15:00 PT). Failing flaky in `integration/db-migrate` on linux. Rerun earlier didn't pick it up. Requesting quick CI rerun + an approval if green. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/15234

alec: I can kick the rerun. Which job should I target? linux-matrix sounds right.

samir: I can approve once CI is green and I skim the one-line change.

ci-bot: queued rerun for PR 15234 (job=linux-matrix). Estimated start ~2m — https://ci.internal/jobs/12345

alec: running `/ci rerun --pr 15234 --job linux-matrix` now.

ci-bot: job started on runner `linux-prod-7` — collecting logs...

maya: quick note — this is just a 1-line timeout bump in the migration test, safe to land before freeze if tests pass.

alec: first rerun still hit the `integration/db-migrate` flake. Kicking focused rerun: `/ci rerun --pr 15234 --job integration/db-migrate --focus`

ci-bot: all checks passed ✅ (linux-matrix: pass, unit: pass, lint: pass). Merge checks show approvals 0/1 required: 0/1.

samir: LGTM. approving now.

jen: reminder — freeze window starts 2026-03-18 15:00 PT. If this isn't merged by cutoff, it will be held for the next window. Prefer to avoid last-minute rush; good candidate for a quick canary if needed.

release-captain: If CI is green and there's at least 1 approval we can merge. Ping me right before you merge and I'll reserve a canary slot for the post-merge smoke.

maya: ok i'm going to merge once CI mark is steady. pinging @release-captain now.

alec: merged via `gh pr merge 15234 --squash --delete-branch`. Deployed to staging. @ci-bot please run staging-smoke.

ci-bot: staging-smoke job passed — smoke OK on staging. smoke logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/12345/smoke

release-captain: good to go, scheduling canary at 2026-03-18 14:50 PT. thanks everyone :tada:

maya: thanks all — closing the loop.
